physics-killer-11.goal: Analyze the principles of irlik kuchi e and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-11.material: Bir jinsli $B$ magnit maydoniga perpendikulyar P zarracha kirib tekis aylanma harakat qiladi, orbita radiusi $5\,\mathrm{cm}$, davri $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Q zarracha P bilan bir xil magnit maydoniga perpendikulyar kiradi, massasi P ning $4$ barobari, zaryad kattaligi P ning $2$ barobari, tezligi P ning $3$ barobari. Og'irlik kuchi e'tiborga olinmaydi. Q ning orbita radiusi va davri tartib bilan to'g'ri juftlangan javob qaysi?
physics-killer-11.s.s1.prompt: Bir jinsli $B$ magnit maydoniga perpendikulyar P zarracha kirib tekis aylanma harakat qiladi, orbita radiusi $5\,\mathrm{cm}$, davri $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. physics-killer-11.s.s1.explain: $r\propto\dfrac{mv}{q}$ bo'lgani uchun $\dfrac{r_Q}{r_P}=\dfrac{4m\cdot3v}{2q}\cdot\dfrac{q}{mv}=6\Rightarrow r_Q=5\times6=30\,\mathrm{cm}$. $T=\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$ tezlikka bog'liq emas, shuning uchun $\dfrac{T_Q}{T_P}=\dfrac{4}{2}=2\Rightarrow T_Q=4\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Zaryad nisbatini tushirib qoldirsa $r=60\,\mathrm{cm}$, $T=8\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (noto'g'ri javob ①), davr tezlikka proporsional deb hisoblasa $12\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (noto'g'ri javob ③), massa va zaryad nisbatlarini butunlay e'tiborga olmay faqat tezlik nisbatini ishlatsa $r=15\,\mathrm{cm}$ (noto'g'ri javob ④).
